notes: Sourced from the manufacturer's official AMX/Harman Pro datasheet (PDF, revised 11.18.16), fetched via redirect from amx.com/en-US/product_documents/nx-1200-datasheet-pdf. All I/O on this unit are captive 3.5mm mini-Phoenix screw-terminal connectors (mapped to closest available connector id 'euroblock'/'euroblock-dc') rather than XLR/TRS/etc; pin counts vary per port (2-pin, 4-pin, 5-pin, 6-pin, 10-pin) as noted. No bandwidth grade is published for AxLink or the RS-232/422/485/IR/IO control ports, so grade is omitted there per rules. Ethernet is explicitly 10/100 (eth-100m). USB generation is not stated on the datasheet; assumed USB 2.0 (typical for this control-processor's era) - grade inferred, lowering confidence slightly on that detail only. This is a compact desktop/shelf unit (1RU height x 1/3 rack width) requiring an optional rack tray (AVB-VSTYLE-RMK) to occupy a full rack space, so rackUnits omitted. Power is supplied via an external 12VDC (9-18VDC range) adapter connecting to a captive 3.5mm Phoenix terminal (not a barrel jack or IEC inlet); no AC mains connector exists on the unit itself.

ports.name: TO PC (Program Port)
ports.note: USB Standard B port for NetLinx Studio programming

ports.name: USB Host Port
ports.note: USB Standard A host port for firmware updates, file transfer, mass storage

ports.name: AxLink
ports.note: 4-position 3.5mm screw-terminal (mini-Phoenix) AxLink control bus port, provides data and power to external AxLink devices

ports.name: RS-232/422/485
ports.note: 10-position 3.5mm screw-terminal (mini-Phoenix); NetLinx Port 1; supports RS-232, RS-422, or RS-485 selectable

ports.name: IR/Serial 1
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw-terminal; 1-way IR or serial transmit port; NetLinx Port 11; carriers up to 1.142 MHz

ports.name: IR/Serial 2
ports.note: 2-position 3.5mm screw-terminal; 1-way IR or serial transmit port; NetLinx Port 12; carriers up to 1.142 MHz

ports.name: I/O 1-4
ports.note: One 6-position 3.5mm screw-terminal providing 4-channel binary I/O for contact closure with voltage sensing; NetLinx Port 22, channels 1-4

ports.name: IRRX
ports.note: 1/8 inch (3.5mm) mini-jack IR receive input port

ports.name: INPUT PWR
ports.note: 2-pin 3.5mm mini-Phoenix DC power input with retaining screws; 12VDC typical (9-18VDC range), 200mA draw; external power supply (e.g. PSR5.4) required, not included
